title: Point
sessionHistoryNote: The hub doesn’t keep per-session charging history — today is shown.
deleteBody: The point stops being metered and leaves the overview. Deleting the point erases its stored history for good — download it first in History (CSV) if you need it. The sensor channel stays and can be used for a new point.
deleteRequestFailed: The delete request failed — no connection to the hub.
deleteLocked: The main input and the voltage bus cannot be deleted.
capCurrentOnly: current only — monitoring, not energy metering
basicReversed: The current sensor seems fitted backwards: the BASIC module sees {w} «in reverse» but meters forward flow only — this load is NOT being metered. Turn the sensor round on the wire (arrow on the body towards the load).
ctClip: The current hits the sensor's limit: everything above it is clipped and metering under-counts. A higher-rated sensor is needed.
ctWarn: The load is near the sensor's limit ({pct} % of its rating): above the limit the current is clipped and metering under-counts.
noChannel: Channel {ch} is not on the fitted module ({model}, {n} channels). The point and its history are kept — data resumes when a module with this channel is back. Don’t unbind the point: unbinding deletes its history.
sctUncorrected: This point’s readings are not corrected for its current transformer ({why}). Values may differ from the real ones — check the sensor model in this point’s settings («Point settings» → «Current sensor»).
liveOnly: This point shows live values only — it has no stored history.
liveOnlyNamed: {name} shows live values only — it has no stored history.
historyFull: The hub keeps history for {n} points.
historyRestart: Restart the hub to start its history.
